technique_name: Compare the two solutions mentioned below and choose the most suitable one
description: Solution A is the most suitable solution as it does not involve replacing the existing manual process, but rather automating it to increase efficiency. Automating a process can more quickly and easily make changes to the process, eliminate redundant steps, and speak to areas of improvement. With automation, user experience can also be improved. Replacing the existing process would involve a longer and more costly process of redesigning and implementing a new process, potentially leading to poten
example:
Solution A: Automate the manual process to improve efficiency. 
Solution B: Replace the existing process with a newly designed one.
